subject.size_in_frame: the sh060 frame exactly — face about 0.50 of frame height, held

second_subject.note: eaten down to nothing across the shot; the crumbs are then brushed off the pinafore inside the same frame.

headroom: about 0.16 of frame height, identical to sh060 and never adjusted — the two seconds of nothing happening have to happen in a frame that visibly has not changed.
horizon_eyeline: Identical to sh060: low close at 0.18 m, slight up-angle, her eyeline at 0.44.

layers.fg: the cake, then the crumbs, then her hand brushing the pinafore

gaze.note: on the two-second hold her look comes level and very nearly to the lens — the flat, cheated, deadpan address that is the joke. It is not a stare at the audience; it is a look at nothing, which happens to be where the camera is. Then she drops her eyes and simply eats.

balance: Absolutely static and centred, held past the point where a cut would normally come. The stillness is the comedy.
leading_lines: None. The frame is deliberately inert for two full seconds — no line, no motion, no change of light.
eye_first: Her face, and then nowhere, for two seconds.
constraint_binding: The two-second hold on the flat, cheated face is the joke and is NOT cut into: the composition offers no alternative framing, no insert and no second subject during the hold, so an internal cut is impossible. Then she eats briskly and without ceremony — the eating is played inside the same unchanged frame, with no size change to dignify it.
pairs_with: sh060 — the same low close, held.
